Book companion

Companion Excel workbooks

Free for readers of The European Business Compliance Handbook — 2027 Edition. One workbook per chapter, one sheet per record in the book.

Download all 10 workbooks (ZIP)

ZIP · 275 KB

Download by chapter

Each file opens in Microsoft Excel or LibreOffice Calc. No sign-up, no tracking.

  • 1 · GDPR complianceProcessing records, data subject requests, breaches, processors, cookie audit · XLSX · 34 KB
  • 2 · Vendor and AI supplier assessmentSupplier register and assessment log · XLSX · 18 KB
  • 3 · AI compliance toolkitAI inventory, privacy checkpoints, actions, learning, incidents, reviews · XLSX · 38 KB
  • 4 · AI workplace policyTool requests and policy acknowledgements · XLSX · 18 KB
  • 5 · Pay transparencyJob evaluation, pay data, pay-gap assessment, requests, actions, sign-off · XLSX · 45 KB
  • 6 · Whistleblower channelsSetup tasks, handlers, national rules, confidential case record · XLSX · 30 KB
  • 7 · NIS2 cybersecurityScope, registration, roles, controls, risks, suppliers, incidents, evidence · XLSX · 63 KB
  • 8 · European Accessibility ActScope, authorities, assets, WCAG tests, barriers, feedback, burden assessment · XLSX · 46 KB
  • 9 · Digital Services ActService classification, notices and decisions, contact points · XLSX · 25 KB
  • 10 · E-invoicing readinessApplicability, mandates, action plan, invoice fields, providers, partners, sign-off · XLSX · 44 KB

What's inside each workbook

  • One sheet per record from the book (1A–10G), with the same field names, so the book and the workbook line up.
  • Fictional example rows from the book, so you can see what a good entry looks like — overwrite or delete them.
  • Automatic calculations in grey (auto) columns: request deadlines, NIS2 24 h / 72 h / final-report deadlines, risk scores, pay-gap percentage, overdue checks.
  • Pre-filled catalogues: AI checkpoints, pay-transparency actions, whistleblowing setup tasks, NIS2 controls, WCAG checks, e-invoicing tasks and invoice fields.
  • Dropdowns and warning colours — red for overdue, amber for due within 30 days.
  • An overview sheet with a legend and links to every sheet.
